project.title: CSS Checker C++
project.summary: Fast C++ CLI for finding and safely removing unused CSS classes in JS/TS, Razor, and Web Forms projects.

items.title: Harden stylesheet replace so a failed rename cannot delete the live CSS
items.notes: Critical from code review: cleanup_file removes the destination on rename failure then retries; if the second rename fails the live stylesheet is gone (worse when an older .backup was preserved). Never delete the live file; prefer copy/replace or rename-aside with rollback. Cover with a regression test.

items.title: Extract CSS class definitions from selectors only
items.notes: High from code review: dots in values such as url(/assets/hero.webp) become fake classes (.webp) and are mislabelled as kept compound selectors. Reuse the selector walk from exact vs compound cleanup.

items.title: Narrow opaque/computed binding impact on unused reporting
items.notes: High from code review: one opaque binding (e.g. className={styles.btn}) marks every class without a literal hit as Unknown project-wide and can force exit 0. Scope opacity, or still report unused with clear suppression counts and docs.

items.title: Align --ignore matching with documented full-match semantics
items.notes: Medium from code review: help says class names are fully matched; should_ignore_class uses std::regex_search so btn ignores btn-primary. Switch to regex_match or fix help/README to require anchors.

items.title: Stop labelling non-selector class hits as kept compound selectors
items.notes: Medium from code review: analyze_files puts anything not exact into kept, including phantoms with no selector use. Use exact / complex / not-in-selector buckets. Pairs with extract-classes-from-selectors-only.

items.title: Fail the process when the markdown report cannot be written
items.notes: Medium from code review: generate_markdown_report logs and returns on open failure while main still exits 0/1. Return bool and map to exit 2 when a report was requested.

items.title: Cache line offsets instead of re-splitting files for every context line
items.notes: Medium from code review: get_line_context splits the whole file per hit (O(occurrences × size)). Compute line starts once per file or gather context lazily.

items.title: Split usage_detector.cpp into focused indexing modules
items.notes: High maintainability from code review: ~1.4k-line anonymous namespace mixes markup, JS calls, jQuery, Angular host bindings, and style refs. Split behind the UsageDetector façade after correctness fixes; keep behavioural tests green.

items.title: Add a reproducible benchmark suite
items.notes: README states there is no benchmark suite and therefore claims no speedup over other tools. Add fixtures and a documented way to measure scan/index time so performance claims can be evidence-based.

items.title: Add end-to-end fixtures for React + ASP.NET mixed trees
items.notes: README examples cover wwwroot, ClientApp, and Web Forms extensions. Add checked-in fixtures exercised via ctest that mirror those layouts, including opaque-binding and cleanup interactions called out in review.

items.title: Run build and ctest on macOS in CI
items.notes: README documents Linux/macOS CMake builds; CI currently covers Linux and Windows only. Assumption: adding macos-latest is desirable for the claimed cross-platform support.

items.title: Document ready-made --code-ext presets for Vue, Svelte, and HTML
items.notes: README already explains adding extensions. Ship copy-paste presets in getting-started or FAQ so newcomers do not invent incomplete lists.
